visualCharacteristics.structure: icon + heading link + text (3-col grid, 12 items)

contentPattern: 12 rows, 1 cell each: H3 containing ':icon: ' + link (e.g. ':medical-services: Health care' -> /health-care), paragraph description. Icon tokens render as span.icon.icon-NAME; recognised names with colour hooks: medical-services, description, school, work, handshake, home, shield, star, id-card, flag, groups, account-balance.
